d1e3.t: Using USB Flash Drive Mode (Audio Inputs)
d1e3.d: Using USB Flash Mode allows you to play downloaded music through a thumb drive in your car without needing to use a mobile device. The transmiter will read the music files and broadcast them over your car's radio

d1e10.t: Bluetooth Calling Features of the Multi-Function Button:
d1e10.d: This button also has multiple features for Bluetooth calling allowing for hands-free operation and minimal distractions.

d1e17.t: Adjusting Volume and Using Bass Boost Button
d1e17.d: Adjusting the audio of your car radio, your connected devices, and utilizing the Bass Boost Button improves the quality of sound and provides bass music quality.

d1e24.t: Music-Playing Features of the Multi-Function Button:
d1e24.d: The Multi-Function Button has several music-playing features that can be used for controlling music playback.

d1e31.t: What are the Two Audio Inputs?
d1e31.d: The two audio inputs this device provides are Bluetooth Mode and USB Flash Drive Mode. The following section defines and covers the differences between using these two inputs.

d1e39.t: Setting-Up the FM Transmitter in Your Car
d1e39.d: To begin using the device, you need to set it up to your car's radio station.
